name: Celastrus the Bitter
summary: Thylaen asks you to destroy Celastrus, a corrupted thorn-bush on Hyjal's eastern slopes. Its poisoned growth threatens the mountain's undergrowth.

sections.title: A Bitter Growth
sections.body: Fel energies have twisted the plants on Hyjal, leaving weeds and growth corrupted and poisonous. Thylaen needs you to find Celastrus the Bitter on the eastern slopes and bring back a broken frond. The thorn-bush kills animals and feeds on the dead, while the undergrowth struggles to recover.

faq.answer: Celastrus the Bitter is a great thorn-bush on Hyjal's eastern slopes, corrupted by fel energies.

faq.q: Why does Thylaen want Celastrus destroyed?
faq.answer: Celastrus kills animals, lashes out at other plants, and feeds on the dead. Thylaen says clearing the weeds will help the mountain regrow.
Fel energies that fell on the mountain long ago have left its weeds and plants angry, corrupted, and poisoned.

faq.q: What does Thylaen ask me to bring back?
faq.answer: Thylaen asks you to return with a broken frond from Celastrus.

faq.q: What does Thylaen say after Celastrus is destroyed?
faq.answer: Thylaen says the trimmed hedge will make the undergrowth less dangerous and that Hyjal will bloom again.

attribution: In-game quest text: Celastrus the Bitter
